name: Cline
tagline: Open-source coding agent for IDE, CLI, desktop, and cloud, with plan and act modes.
description: Cline is an open-source coding agent distributed as VS Code and JetBrains extensions, a CLI, a desktop app, an SDK, and a cloud service. It supports plan/act workflows, MCP, coordinator agents that delegate to specialists, and parallel sessions.

pricing.notes: Free open-source extension and CLI; optional Cline provider credits and ClinePass subscription.
